execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "identity"
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "identity"."audit_log" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actor_email" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entity_id" uuid,
  "entity_name" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" inet NOT NULL,
  "new_value" jsonb,
  "old_value" jsonb,
  "request_id" text,
  "status" text,
  "user_agent" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "identity"."password_reset_tokens" (
  "created_at" timestamp(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "device_id" text,
  "expires_at" timestamp(6) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" inet,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "used_at" timestamp(6),
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "identity"."refresh_tokens" (
  "created_at" timestamp(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "device_id" text,
  "expires_at" timestamp(6) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" inet,
  "replaced_by_token" uuid,
  "revoked_at" timestamp(6),
  "revoked_reason" text,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "identity"."role_claims" (
  "claim_type" text NOT NULL,
  "claim_value" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "role_id" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "identity"."roles" (
  "created_at" timestamp(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamp(6),
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "normalized_name" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(6),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "identity"."user_claims" (
  "claim_type" text NOT NULL,
  "claim_value" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "identity"."user_logins" (
  "created_at" timestamp(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamp(6),
  "login_provider" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("login_provider", "value")
)

CREATE TABLE "identity"."user_roles" (
  "role_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "role_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "identity"."user_tokens" (
  "created_at" timestamp(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamp(6),
  "login_provider" text NOT NULL,
  "token_name" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "login_provider", "token_name")
)

CREATE TABLE "identity"."users" (
  "account_status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamp(6),
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "email_verified_at" timestamp(6),
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "normalized_email" text NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "phone_number" text NOT NULL,
  "phone_verified_at" timestamp(6),
  "updated_at" timestamp(6),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_account_status_check_6d1da24a" CHECK ("account_status" IN ('active', 'inactive', 'locked', 'suspended'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."admins" (
  "created_at" timestamp(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "first_name" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "last_name" text NOT NULL,
  "profile_image_url" text,
  "updated_at" timestamp(6),
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
